cohort: 148 infants who failed the Infant Car Seat Challenge (ICSC) on the Mother-Baby Unit and were subsequently admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Prentice Women's Hospital between January 1, 2009, and December 31, 2015
finding: Infants who failed the ICSC were at risk for comorbid conditions that prolonged hospital stay beyond the neonatal intensive care unit observation period.
